sections.title: Prime Day 2026: Predicted Dates and Deal Strategy
sections.content: Analysis of historical trends points to July 14-15, 2026. Focus on 'ecosystem' deals: Amazon Echo with integrated LLMs, high-speed SSDs for AI local storage, and current-gen GPU clearances.

sections.title: The AI Laptop Revolution: Back-to-School Picks

subsections.title: Snapdragon X Elite 2: The Battery Life King
subsections.details: The 2026 refresh brings 55+ NPU TOPS and 24-hour real-world battery life. Ideal for students who need power without the charger.

subsections.title: Intel Lunar Lake 2: Performance Meets AI Efficiency
subsections.details: Intel's refined architecture focuses on single-core speed and improved NPU integration for creative apps like Adobe Firefly.

sections.title: Samsung Unpacked July 2026: Foldables & Wearables
sections.details: Galaxy Z Fold 8 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 12.1mm thickness) and Galaxy Watch 9 (Advanced AI Sleep Coaching). Strategy: Focus on trade-in values rather than direct discounts.

faq.question: Is 16GB RAM enough for 2026 AI tasks?
faq.answer: In 2026, 16GB is the absolute minimum for Copilot+ PCs. For future-proofing, 32GB is highly recommended for local LLM execution.

faq.question: Should I buy a laptop on Prime Day or wait for August?
faq.answer: If you are a student, wait for late July/early August 'Back-to-School' bundles which often include high-value accessories for free.
